hits.snippet: ### Melanie Westergaard Image Image ## Pamela Wicks, CPA, CMA, ICD.D Ms. Wicks was appointed President and CEO of Pulse in August 2026. She was previously the VP Finance and CFO of the company and will continue as the acting CFO during the search for her replacement. Ms. Wicks joined Pulse Seismic Inc. in 2002 as Corporate Controller, was promoted to Vice President of Finance in 2007, and was appointed Chief Financial Officer in 2010. [...] ## Melanie Westergaard Ms. Westergaard is an independent businessperson with over 38 years of global experience in the oil and gas industry. She began her career in the geophysical services industry with Western Geophysical, followed by more than 18 years with the multinational oil company ARCO/BP, where she held roles ranging from geophysicist to multi-asset management and leadership positions. Ms. Westergaard further honed her geophysical and managerial expertise across a variety of geologic basins, pursuing both unconventional and conventional play types with Forest Oil, Ovintiv, and as a consultant for a number of oil and gas operators.
